narrative: Material PL1__M2DE263B exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.53, mean=467 units/day) with a slight declining trend. Lead time shows moderate variability (mean=2.66 days, CV=0.46), with transport uncertainty accounting for 60% of lead time variance. The current SAP safety stock of 440 units is materially insufficient; the optimized safety stock of 1,148 units is required to achieve the 95% service level target. An (r,Q) policy with EOQ-derived order quantity of 4,235 units reduces ordering frequency by 70% and delivers total annual cost savings of $1,798.58 (33.9%).

research_insights.selection_rationale: With erratic but predominantly non-zero demand (93% active days) and moderate lead-time variability, a continuous-review (r,Q) policy provides prompt replenishment triggers and leverages EOQ to balance ordering and holding costs efficiently.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity constraint is not binding: SS(1148) + OQ(4235) = 5383 units, well within max_storage_units(8028). No service or cost risk from storage capacity.
